sentences.hanzi: 星期六的下午，丽丽和小明一起整理家里的旧书架。
sentences.pinyin: Xīngqīliù de xiàwǔ, Lìlì hé Xiǎomíng yīqǐ zhěnglǐ jiā lǐ de jiù shūjià.
sentences.english: On Saturday afternoon, Lili and Xiaoming tidied up the old bookshelf at home together.

sentences.hanzi: 书架上有好多旧书和旧本子。
sentences.pinyin: Shūjià shàng yǒu hǎoduō jiù shū hé jiù běnzi.
sentences.english: There were many old books and old notebooks on the bookshelf.

sentences.hanzi: 忽然，小明发现了一本很旧的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Hūrán, Xiǎomíng fāxiàn le yī běn hěn jiù de bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Xiaoming found a very old notebook.

sentences.hanzi: “姐姐，你看，这是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: "Jiějie, nǐ kàn, zhè shì shénme?"
sentences.english: "Sister, look, what is this?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽拿过来一看，说：“这是爷爷年轻时的笔记本！”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì ná guòlái yī kàn, shuō: "Zhè shì yéye niánqīng shí de bǐjìběn!"
sentences.english: Lili took it and looked, saying, "This is Grandpa's notebook from when he was young!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明开心地说：“真的吗？我们快看看吧！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng kāixīn de shuō: "Zhēn de ma? Wǒmen kuài kànkan ba!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said happily, "Really? Let's take a look quickly!"

sentences.hanzi: 他们一页一页地翻看。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yī yè yī yè de fānkàn.
sentences.english: They turned the pages one by one.

sentences.hanzi: 笔记本里有很多爷爷写的古诗。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐjìběn lǐ yǒu hěn duō yéye xiě de gǔshī.
sentences.english: In the notebook were many classical poems written by Grandpa.

sentences.hanzi: 有的诗写的是山，有的诗写的是水。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de shī xiě de shì shān, yǒu de shī xiě de shì shuǐ.
sentences.english: Some poems were about mountains, and some poems were about water.

sentences.hanzi: 旁边还有爷爷画的山水画。
sentences.pinyin: Pángbiān hái yǒu yéye huà de shānshuǐhuà.
sentences.english: Beside them were landscape paintings drawn by Grandpa.

sentences.hanzi: 山高高的，水清清的，画得真好看。
sentences.pinyin: Shān gāogāo de, shuǐ qīngqīng de, huà de zhēn hǎokàn.
sentences.english: The mountains were tall, the water was clear, and they were painted so beautifully.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“爷爷的字真漂亮！”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Yéye de zì zhēn piàoliang!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "Grandpa's handwriting is really beautiful!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明也说：“这些画也很美！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng yě shuō: "Zhèxiē huà yě hěn měi!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming also said, "These paintings are also very beautiful!"

sentences.hanzi: 他们看了很久，都很喜欢这本笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kàn le hěn jiǔ, dōu hěn xǐhuan zhè běn bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: They looked at it for a long time and both really liked this notebook.

sentences.hanzi: 下个星期二是教师节。
sentences.pinyin: Xià gè xīngqī'èr shì Jiàoshījié.
sentences.english: Next Tuesday is Teacher's Day.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我们把这本笔记本送给语文老师吧！”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒmen bǎ zhè běn bǐjìběn sòng gěi yǔwén lǎoshī ba!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "Let's give this notebook to our Chinese teacher!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“好主意！老师一定很喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Hǎo zhǔyi! Lǎoshī yīdìng hěn xǐhuan."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Great idea! The teacher will definitely like it very much."

sentences.hanzi: 他们还亲手写了一张感谢卡。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen hái qīnshǒu xiě le yī zhāng gǎnxiè kǎ.
sentences.english: They also personally wrote a thank-you card.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽在卡片上写：“老师，谢谢您教我们读书和写字。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zài kǎpiàn shàng xiě: "Lǎoshī, xièxie nín jiāo wǒmen dúshū hé xiězì."
sentences.english: Lili wrote on the card: "Teacher, thank you for teaching us to read and write."

sentences.hanzi: 小明也写：“祝您教师节快乐！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng yě xiě: "Zhù nín Jiàoshījié kuàilè!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming also wrote: "Happy Teacher's Day!"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸和妈妈看见了，都很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba hé māma kànjiàn le, dōu hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: Dad and Mom saw this and were both very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“你们真懂事。”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba shuō: "Nǐmen zhēn dǒngshì."
sentences.english: Dad said, "You are really thoughtful."

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“老师帮助你们很多，你们要记得感谢老师。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Lǎoshī bāngzhù nǐmen hěn duō, nǐmen yào jìde gǎnxiè lǎoshī."
sentences.english: Mom said, "The teacher has helped you a lot, so you should remember to thank the teacher."

sentences.hanzi: 全家人坐在沙发上，一起说老师对他们的帮助。
sentences.pinyin: Quán jiā rén zuò zài shāfā shàng, yīqǐ shuō lǎoshī duì tāmen de bāngzhù.
sentences.english: The whole family sat on the sofa and talked together about the teacher's help to them.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“语文老师很耐心，教你们读古诗。”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba shuō: "Yǔwén lǎoshī hěn nàixīn, jiāo nǐmen dú gǔshī."
sentences.english: Dad said, "The Chinese teacher is very patient and teaches you to read classical poems."

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“她还常常鼓励你们好好学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Tā hái chángcháng gǔlì nǐmen hǎohǎo xuéxí."
sentences.english: Mom said, "She also often encourages you to study hard."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“对，有一次我写不好字，老师一直帮我。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Duì, yǒu yī cì wǒ xiě bù hǎo zì, lǎoshī yīzhí bāng wǒ."
sentences.english: Lili said, "Right, once I couldn't write characters well, and the teacher kept helping me."

sentences.hanzi: 小明也说：“老师还说我读书读得越来越好了。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng yě shuō: "Lǎoshī hái shuō wǒ dúshū dú de yuè lái yuè hǎo le."
sentences.english: Xiaoming also said, "The teacher also said that my reading is getting better and better."

sentences.hanzi: 大家说着说着，都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā shuō zhe shuō zhe, dōu xiào le.
sentences.english: As everyone talked and talked, they all laughed.

sentences.hanzi: 这个下午，家里很温馨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàwǔ, jiā lǐ hěn wēnxīn.
sentences.english: That afternoon, the home was very warm and cozy.

sentences.hanzi: 他们决定，教师节那天把礼物和卡片一起送给老师。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng, Jiàoshījié nà tiān bǎ lǐwù hé kǎpiàn yīqǐ sòng gěi lǎoshī.
sentences.english: They decided to give the gift and the card to the teacher together on Teacher's Day.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽和小明觉得，这真是一件很有意义的事。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì hé Xiǎomíng juéde, zhè zhēn shì yī jiàn hěn yǒu yìyì de shì.
sentences.english: Lili and Xiaoming felt that this was truly a very meaningful thing.
